description.text: Students mainly study in the basic theories and knowledge in math, foundamental physics, physical electronics, optoelectronics, microelectronics. And they will take the basic training at information electronic experiment technology, computer technology, the ability to design, research and develop electronic materials, component and system. This program is designed to turn out highly-qualified professionals armed with a sound basic knowledge of theories and expertise in electronical materials, component, integrate circuit, developing and researching new technology, etc. Given the strong focus on Micro-Electronics, graduates will be particularly well equipped for employment in the micro-electronics industry. Main Courses: Fundamentals of Electric Circuits, Computer Architecture Foundation and Logical Design, Introduction to Electronical Science and Technology, Signal and System, Fundamentals of Electronic Circuits, Micro Computer System and Interface, Theory of Electromagnetic Fields, Semiconductor Physics, Photoelectron Physical Basis, Electronic Device, VLSI Design, Display Technology, Photoelectronic Technique, Fiber Optic Communications, Digital Signal Processing, etc.

duration.text: The Electrical Engineering and Automation at Qingdao University is a 4 Years long program for international students, taught in Chinese.

fees.text: Application Fee: $ 150 USD Service Fee: $ 50 USD Tuition fee: $ 2500 USD/per year ￥ 18000 CNY/per year

materials.text: 1. Certificate of HSK Band 3 or above for Chinese Language Program, and Band 6 or above for other majors. 2. Photocopy of valid passport With name, passport number & expiration date, and photo included 3. Passport photo A recent passport-sized photo of the applicant 4. High school graduate certificate Graduation certificate in both English and Chinese and be certified by notarization. 5. High school academic transcript Both in English and Chinese 6. Certificate of employment Applicants who have a job should provide certificate of employment, no need for applicants who haven\'t work. Certificate should be written in English and Chinese. 7. Resume Written in Chinese and in English

requirements.text: 1. Aged 18 to 60 years old; 2. Be in good health condition 3. Applicant should hold high school graduation or equivalent to a Chinese high school graduate 4. HSK level 6 or above 5. Pass the entrance examination (have to apply with the passport in the international students office at July 11th.for knowing the place of exam)
